summary.mn: LED асахад аль болох хурдан товч дар. Хугацааг мс-ээр харуулна.
summary.en: Press the button as soon as the LED lights. Shows your time in ms.

what_you_learn.en: Reading inputs and timing with millis().

text.mn: LED: D8→a5, резистор c5→c8, LED e8 (урт) / e9, a9→(−).
text.en: LED: D8→a5, resistor c5→c8, LED e8 (long) / e9, a9→(−).

text.mn: Товч: e15, e17, f15, f17. a15→D2, a17→(−). Код дотоод pull-up ашигладаг тул резистор хэрэггүй.
text.en: Button: e15, e17, f15, f17. a15→D2, a17→(−). The code uses the built-in pull-up, so no resistor.
Upload the code and open the Serial Monitor.

test.mn: LED асмагц товч дарна: Serial Monitor дээр хугацаа гарна (ихэвчлэн 200–300 мс).
test.en: Press as soon as the LED lights: your time shows in the Serial Monitor (usually 200–300 ms).

safety.mn: Arduino-г зөвхөн USB (5В)-ээр тэжээнэ. Утас солихдоо USB-г салгана.
safety.en: Power the Arduino from USB (5V) only. Unplug USB before you change wires.

safety.mn: LED-ийг резисторгүйгээр батарейд шууд холбож болохгүй — шатна.
safety.en: Never connect an LED straight to the battery without its resistor — it burns out.
